summary: The KayKit wall matches the brief's prompt (4 x 4 x 1 m grey stone wall with raised blocks on both faces and a darker band along top and base), uses 494 of its 1320 triangles, passes every colour assertion, and no open loop shows in any view.

findings.observation: Two raised blocks show a small triangular notch in one corner where they overlap the next block (upper-right and lower-left clusters); visible only up close, same on front and back.
The back mirrors the front rather than having its own layout; meets the brief.

23 boundary loops, one per part on block backs flush against the wall; none visible. Only minor corner notches.
